summary: The change adds one file, docs/design/reviews/native-pr-landing-review-2.md. It is an independent review of native-pr-landing.md with eight numbered findings (F1 to F8). Each finding has a severity and cites design lines, and the review ends with the verdict "reject for revision". I checked its citations against the tree. The design's lines 134-136, 142, 105-111 and 155-168 match. In invariant.rs, lines 267-272 say jobs are found from records and never from trailers, and lines 297-303 hold the Athena-Job trailer check. In run.rs, lines 1370-1383 find the commit with log_grep and then parse its trailers, and lines 1400-1404 add a Co-Authored-By trailer. Roadmap lines 33-38 list parallel jobs as item 2 and PR landing as item 3. Parallel-jobs review F1 offers option (a) re-verification or (b) per-job pull requests first. The 2026-10-13 squash evidence is labeled as reported by the user from the host's merge button and not reproduced here. One-job-per-squash is examined against M30 and against pull requests that hold several jobs. The design file itself is unchanged. I ran git status and git diff --stat: the only change is that one new .md file. I ran cargo test --locked and cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings: both pass. The review contains no email addresses or secrets. The brief's deliverables list also named review-1 and a change to the design, but the accepted reading and the scope rules rule both out, so leaving them out is correct. One minor gap: the review proposes a new test without noting that similar gate tests already exist.
